result.summary: No critical visual breakage detected. Page renders correctly; only minor cosmetic inconsistencies and expected carousel/scroll truncations are visible.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' and is cut off at the right screen edge, filter chips also clipped on the right.
issues.suggestion: This looks like expected horizontal scroll affordance, not a break. Ensure edge padding and ellipsis for truncated names if needed.

issues.description: Favorite heart icon has inconsistent treatment: no background/scrim on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card vs dark circular background on pizza card below.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent scrim/background for the favorite button to ensure visibility on all images.

issues.description: Food thumbnails in 'Fastest near you' have inconsistent scale/fill - Green Bowl Poke image appears small with large empty beige area while neighboring cards fill the frame.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image aspect ratio, cropping and background treatment for restaurant thumbnails.
